platformLimits.note: The n8n node UI has no runtime catalogue fetch: methods.loadOptions runs inside the n8n server, so the provider/model pickers read catalog.json, a models.dev snapshot regenerated at build time by `npm run catalog` (part of `npm run build`).

n8n exposes no node-UI i18n API: node descriptions are English-only literals consumed by the editor, and the editor's own locale catalogue covers n8n core strings, not community-node displayName/description/placeholder fields. SPEC 2.1's three provider-required strings therefore ship as English literals (providerPlaceholder, providerRequiredForModel, providerRequiredError) declared once in nodes/Dualtran/translate.ts and referenced from the node description fields, the endpoint placeholder and the request guard; there are no per-locale node files to translate and no legacy string to migrate. The 44 target-language labels come from scripts/catalog-sources/language-names.json.
